about.description:
Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is the first step toward an open
ecosystem that empowers AI developers to choose the right tools as their
project evolves. ONNX provides an open source format for AI models. It
defines an extensible computation graph model, as well as definitions of
built-in operators and standard data types. Initially we focus on the
capabilities needed for inferencing (evaluation).

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "1.22.0"

recipe:
  name: onnx
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/onnx/onnx/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 70bb8b25cf31ea9b1d9f94baacfdc8c4fa27a760f9a10f5d93881bc9eede5fbc
  patches:
    - patches/0001-Patch-Python-and-nanobind-cmake-config.patch
    - patches/0002-Link-protobuf-and-abseil-privately.patch
    - patches/0003-Define-ONNX_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS-when-building-shared-l.patch
    - patches/0004-Decorate-the-protobuf-generated-classes-with-ONNX_AP.patch
    - patches/0005-Install-shared-libraries-to-standard-destinations.patch
    - patches/0006-Link-the-Python-module-against-the-shared-onnx-libra.patch
    - patches/0007-Make-ONNX_API-resolve-to-dllimport-for-shared-librar.patch
    - patches/0008-Annotate-the-remaining-public-C-API-with-ONNX_API.patch

build:
  number: 2

outputs:
  # The ONNX C++ shared library (libonnx / libonnx_proto), headers and the
  # ONNX CMake package. Built directly with CMake and no Python involvement.
  - package:
      name: libonnx
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "build_libonnx.bat" if win else "build_libonnx.sh" }}
      variant:
        # libonnx is a pure C++ library; the Python interpreter is only a
        # build tool (gen_proto.py), so the package is not Python-versioned.
        ignore_keys:
          - python
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        # Python (build platform) only runs gen_proto.py to generate the
        # *.proto sources; no Python headers are needed,
        # so libonnx is not tied to a Python version.
        - python
        # protoc lives in libprotobuf and must match the build platform.
        - libprotobuf
      host:
        - libprotobuf
      run_exports:
        # ONNX offers no stable ABI for its C++ library.
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libonnx', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/libonnx${SHLIB_EXT}"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/libonnx_proto${SHLIB_EXT}"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/ONNX/ONNXConfig.cmake"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/ONNX/ONNXTargets.cmake"
              - test -f "${PREFIX}/include/onnx/onnx_pb.h"
              # protobuf and abseil must be linked privately (patch 0002).
              - grep -q protobuf "${PREFIX}/lib/cmake/ONNX/ONNXTargets.cmake" && exit 1 || true
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\onnx.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\onnx_proto.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\onnx.lib exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\onnx_proto.lib exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\cmake\ONNX\ONNXConfig.cmake exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\include\onnx\onnx_pb.h exit 1

  # The ONNX Python package. The onnx_cpp2py_export extension links the
  # libonnx shared library rather than recompiling ONNX (patch 0005).
  - package:
      name: onnx
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script:
        file: ${{ "build_onnx.bat" if win else "build_onnx.sh" }}
      python:
        entry_points:
          - check-model = onnx.bin.checker:check_model
          - check-node = onnx.bin.checker:check_node
          - backend-test-tools = onnx.backend.test.cmd_tools:main
    requirements:
      build:
        - if: build_platform != target_platform
          then:
            - python
            - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
            - nanobind
            - libprotobuf
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - python
        - pip
        - scikit-build-core
        - nanobind
        - libprotobuf
        - protobuf
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libonnx', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - python
        - ml_dtypes
        - protobuf
        - typing_extensions
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libonnx', exact=True) }}
    tests:
      - python:
          imports:
            - onnx
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pip
        script:
          - pip check
          - check-model --help
          - check-node --help
          - backend-test-tools --help

about:
  license: Apache-2.0
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Open Neural Network Exchange library
  description: |
    Open Neural Network Exchange (ONNX) is the first step toward an open
    ecosystem that empowers AI developers to choose the right tools as their
    project evolves. ONNX provides an open source format for AI models. It
    defines an extensible computation graph model, as well as definitions of
    built-in operators and standard data types. Initially we focus on the
    capabilities needed for inferencing (evaluation).
  homepage: https://github.com/onnx/onnx/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - marcelotrevisani
    - xhochy
    - janjagusch
    - cbourjau
